blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives on Wednesday rejected a budget amendment proposed by Navotas Rep. Toby Tiangco that would have mandated public disclosure of the chamber’s spending and listing all infrastructure projects allotted to each congressional district. The proposed amendments, Tiango said, were aimed at strengthening the “credibility of the House as an institution by demonstrating that accountability applies equally to everyone.” The first amendment would have required the House to publish quarterly breakdowns of the chamber’s spending and an annual report of each lawmaker’s expenses on its official website.
